categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Adds a new fuzz harness in src/test/fuzz/musig.cpp and updates CMakeLists.txt under the Fuzzing label.
categories.rationale: Adds fuzz testing coverage for `src/musig` wrapper functions that previously had no dedicated unit tests or fuzzer targets. As noted by jeanpablojp, 'the four signing functions in the module have no unit test today', so this exercises previously untested error paths and input validation in a sensitive cryptographic module.
